title: WingFoil UI local state (state.json)
description: The local state file of spec-006 §2, version 1. Never holds a token, a session id, a git credential or an environment variable value (REQ-SEC-09).

version.description: Format version; 1 for spec-006. A greater value is read for the known fields only and never written back.

projects.description: The project list, in insertion order (the switcher's order, S-17.1). Ids are unique (checked by the reader).

settings.description: Reserved for the UI settings (v0.2); {} in v0.1.

actionLog.description: Reserved for the action log (REQ-SEC-10); [] in v0.1.

id.description: Opaque id: p_ + 12 lower-case Crockford base32 characters (60 random bits), never derived from the path (REQ-SEC-04).

path.description: Absolute realpath of the working directory at add time (POSIX or Windows).

name.description: dna.project.name, refreshed on every successful open.

remote.description: URL of origin without userinfo, or "" (REQ-SEC-09). The scp-like form user@host:path is kept as typed.

addedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the add.

roleView.description: Last role view chosen for this project (S-22.3); "" = the shell's default.
